summary: Grayscale Zcash Trust (ZEC) filed an 8-K announcing the anticipated listing of its shares on NYSE Arca on or about August 25, 2026, under the symbol ZCSH, and a planned name change to The Zcash ETF, subject to regulatory approvals. The sponsor will amend the Trust Agreement to reflect the name change; outstanding certificates remain valid. This is a routine operational update regarding exchange listing and branding, not a special-situation transaction. No deal terms, premiums, or M&A events are involved. Watch for regulatory approval and actual listing date confirmation, but no risk-arb opportunity exists.
